label: first copy-phase step re-reading orig token 0 (j/k) in length-9 sequences
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit that fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely at step t = L+1 (input = fed-back first original token, output = orig(1)) of length-9 sequences (97% of mass for L=9, 3% L=8; never in original or delimiter phases, never for L<=7). Within that slot it is a rare tail event (~2% of L=9 sequences): it is strongly gated by the identity of the first token, j and k giving ~72% of mass and all top activations, with weaker contributions from p, z, c, u. The second original token also modulates it (orig(1) in 1, z, f, c, p, digits raises the rate), but that only works as an overfit token list. (L==9)&(recall_idx==1) alone covers 89% of mass at 2% precision; adding in_tok in {j,k} gives F1 0.25 and mass recall 0.62 on dev. Magnitudes are small (max 0.013) and the largest ones come from j/k first tokens.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=j (+4.36), phase=2 & in_tok=k (+3.53), orig1=1 (+2.84), phase=2 & out_tok=z (+2.63), to_go=6 (+2.36), orig2=1 (+1.98). Lower it: orig8=- (-2.04), orig7=- (-1.96), orig6=z (-1.55), n_digits=0 (-0.34).
